overview: Pyramids of Giza and the Grand Egyptian Museum in Cairo, a Nile cruise past Luxor's temples, and the Red Sea's coral reefs at Hurghada.
fit: A dream for the 10-year-old who loves history; long days and heat are tough on the 4-year-old, so add pool and beach days.
season: October to March is pleasant (20–28°C). April–September is very hot, especially in Luxor and Aswan (40°C+).

gettingThere.detail: Chennai to Cairo (1-stop via Dubai, Doha or Mumbai)
Cairo to Luxor/Aswan by flight or sleeper train

gettingAround: Hire a licensed guide and driver; Uber works in Cairo.

todo.title: Pyramids of Giza and Sphinx
todo.why: The last Wonder of the ancient world

todo.title: Nile cruise Luxor–Aswan
todo.why: 3–4 nights with temples on the way
todo.book: Pick a 5-star boat with a pool

foodTips: Vegetarian is fairly easy with local dishes.
save: Book cruises and guides through a reputable agency
Travel in late March or November shoulder weeks
safety: Ignore touts at the pyramids; use a licensed guide
kids: Read Egyptian myths with the kids before going
Plan a beach end to the trip
visa: E-visa online (about US$25 per person, single entry, 30 days) on Egypt's official e-visa portal. Visa on arrival is possible for Indians holding certain valid visas (US, UK, Schengen); check current rules.
